operator-walkthrough.ref: Hiring reach (job 2026-10-30-tech-hiring-page W2+W3). What a visitor sees: (1) every page's footer gains one dark line under the gold call strip, 'Hiring automotive technicians: $30.00-$37.50/hr. Open interviews Mondays, 11 AM to 2 PM.', linking to /careers; the band is read from shared/jobOpenings.ts and the line is absent if the automotive role closes or loses its band; (2) the /careers hero and every /careers/<slug> page show a yellow-bordered note: 'Open interviews Mondays, 11 AM to 2 PM. Walk in with an ID and talk with the manager for a few minutes.' (Nour's words, relayed by the manager); (3) each JobPosting description gains the same line under 'Interviews:', so Google's markup matches the page. The footer and the note share one string (OPEN_INTERVIEWS_SHORT). Nothing states schedule, benefits or guaranteed hours. After merge, prerendered pages lack the footer line until prerender-refresh.yml runs and deploys; live screenshots at 390x844 and 1440x900 follow that.
